motion.name: state-duration
motion.purpose: Button color, tab surface, gallery arrow surface and action arrow transform.

motion.name: state-easing
motion.purpose: Implicit CSS easing on the implemented transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion

provenance.visualAuthority: Existing direction contract and supplied school proposal; no approved comp.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on white and paper surfaces.
components.html: Explore our school
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:30px;min-height:52px;padding:13px 23px;border:0;border-radius:3px;font:600 16px/1.4 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s;background:var(--navy,#202a70);color:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--deep,#141c4c)}.ds-primary svg{transition:transform .2s}.ds-primary:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ae6217;outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary,.ds-primary svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Admission action on a navy section; preview includes its supporting surface.
components.html: Explore admissions
components.css: .ds-dark{background:var(--navy,#202a70);padding:24px}.ds-light{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:30px;min-height:52px;padding:13px 23px;border:0;border-radius:3px;font:600 16px/1.4 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s;background:var(--white,#fff);color:var(--navy,#202a70)}.ds-light:hover{background:#eaeafa}.ds-light svg{transition:transform .2s}.ds-light:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ae6217;outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-light,.ds-light svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled enquiry field with native validation and shared focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Your name<input class="ds-input ds-focus" name="name" autocomplete="name" required maxlength="120" placeholder="Full name"></label>
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font:600 14px/1.65 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);color:var(--navy,#202a70)}.ds-input{display:block;width:100%;background:var(--white,#fff);border:1px solid #b5b8c3;border-radius:2px;min-height:46px;padding:10px 12px;font:400 15px/1.65 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#202338);margin-top:8px;caret-color:var(--red,#bd252b)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#6b6d78}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ae6217;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Main Navigation
components.description: Semibold links with a red current-page underline.
components.html: HomeAboutAcademics

components.name: Category Filters
components.description: Paper category controls with navy selected state; preview states are static.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;padding:5px 0 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dddde3)}.ds-filters button{padding:7px 16px;border:0;border-radius:3px;font:400 14px/1.65 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);background:var(--paper,#f7f6f2);color:var(--ink,#202338);min-height:40px;cursor:pointer}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--navy,#202a70);color:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-filters button:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]){background:#e7e8ef}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ae6217;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Academic Pathway Tabs
components.description: Serif tabs with small year labels and a red selected baseline; visual preview only.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-bottom:1px solid #c8cbd9;background:var(--paper,#f7f6f2)}.ds-tabs button{padding:23px 26px;text-align:left;position:relative;font:400 25px/1.3 var(--serif, Playfair, Georgia, serif);color:var(--navy,#202a70);border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;background:none;transition:background .2s;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button span{display:block;font:400 12px/1.4 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);letter-spacing:.045em;margin-bottom:9px;color:var(--muted,#626575)}.ds-tabs button svg{position:absolute;right:24px;top:25px}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-bottom-color:var(--red,#bd252b);background:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:#eeedf0}.ds-focus:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ae6217;outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-tabs button{font-size:17px;padding:17px 10px}.ds-tabs button span{font-size:10px;min-height:28px;max-width:70px}.ds-tabs button svg{display:none}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tabs button{transition:none}}

components.name: Portal Card
components.description: Flat paper container for a practical next step.
components.html:
Student & Staff Portal

Visit the school portal for results and staff access.
components.css: .ds-card{padding:45px;background:var(--paper,#f7f6f2)}.ds-card h2{margin:0;font:500 36px/1.16 var(--serif, Playfair, Georgia, serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--navy,#202a70);text-wrap:balance}.ds-card p{font:400 17px/1.65 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);color:var(--muted,#626575);margin:23px 0 0}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-card{padding:30px}}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-card{padding:28px}.ds-card h2{font-size:33px}}

components.html:

components.css: .ds-motto{background:var(--navy,#202a70);padding:52px 48px;color:var(--white,#fff);position:relative}.ds-mark{font:400 100px/.8 var(--serif, Playfair, Georgia, serif);color:#b9bfde}.ds-motto blockquote{font:400 44px/1.3 var(--serif, Playfair, Georgia, serif);margin:4px 0 24px;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-motto>p{color:#d7dbed;font:400 20px/1.65 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);margin:0}.ds-caption{display:block;margin-top:45px;border-top:1px solid #576090;padding-top:21px;font:400 10px/1.65 var(--sans, SourceSans, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);letter-spacing:.15em;color:#d7dbed}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-motto{padding:35px 28px}.ds-motto blockquote{font-size:36px}}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-motto{padding:36px}.ds-motto blockquote{font-size:39px}.ds-caption{margin-top:25px}}

narrative.overview:
The school crest anchors a traditional academic identity: navy and white provide structure, red marks emphasis, and warm paper gives longer passages room to breathe. Elegant serif headings sit beside clear sans-serif body copy. The overall character is welcoming, composed and practical.

This is a source-derived record of the implemented design, refreshed from the existing direction contract. There is no approved visual comp. The supplied crest and motto, generous whitespace and restrained animation are durable commitments from the school proposal. The implementation in `app/globals.css`, `app/page.js` and `components/` is the evidence for the values below; the companion sidecar holds preview snippets and schema extensions.
keyCharacteristics: Crest-led navy, red and white identity with warm paper surfaces.
Editorial serif headings and readable sans-serif text.
Spacious columns, fine rules and mostly flat surfaces.
Restrained motion with visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Crest Rule
rules.body: Preserve the supplied crest's navy, red and white identity and its original proportions.

rules.name: The Editorial Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary content flat; use rules and tonal surfaces before adding elevation.

dos: Do preserve the supplied crest, its proportions and the school motto.
Do pair editorial serif headings with readable sans-serif body text.
Do use whitespace, fine rules and tonal surfaces to structure content.
Do maintain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't introduce a competing palette or alter the crest colors.
Don't turn ordinary editorial sections into heavily rounded, shadowed cards.
Don't add continuous decorative animation to this restrained system.
Don't substitute invented campus imagery for school-approved photographs.
